error_taxonomy.interpretation: A positive selected by dense retrieval is excluded by hybrid fusion at the saved operating points.
Both systems reject a gold positive; ranks distinguish cutoff rejection from absence in the saved top-100 lists.
Hybrid fusion introduces a false positive relative to the dense decision.
Both systems accept a usage outside the annotated target sense.

taxonomy_scope: Exhaustive, mutually exclusive operational categories for hybrid errors. These are observable outcomes, not manually validated linguistic causes.
example_selection: Seed 42 fixed before analysis; within each category prefer different lemmas, then contexts nearest 180 characters, then sentence_id. Include the full unedited usage and definition.

context_diagnostics.historical: Integer year < 1950; descriptive slice, not a temporal holdout.
context_diagnostics.zero_definition_overlap: No exact NFKC/lowercased alphabetic token shared with the definition after removing a fixed small Swedish function-word list and tokens shorter than 3 characters; no stemming.
context_diagnostics.noise_marker: Replacement character, an angle bracket, or an alphanumeric token containing both letters and digits; a narrow surface proxy, not an OCR annotation.
